snapshot.note: These are proposals for improving decision-making. Each is PENDING REVIEW: a reviewer chooses the best path before any change is implemented. None is implemented yet.

suggestions.title: Author a versioned line-origination model spec
suggestions.rationale: A reproducible, documented model is required before any originated line can be published or validated.
suggestions.impact: High — unlocks the lines page and the data-integrity gate.

suggestions.title: Build an official-source input manifest for the signal pipeline
suggestions.rationale: Mirror the existing official-source manifest (URL, HTTP status, SHA-256, retrieved timestamp) for every signal input so VG-1 is auditable.
suggestions.impact: High — makes data integrity verifiable line by line.

suggestions.title: Publish measured correlation values and set the parlay cap
suggestions.rationale: Correlation values are currently blank/UNVERIFIED; parlay and prop-combo strategies cannot be built or gated without them.
suggestions.impact: High — required for S4/S5/S8 and gate VG-4.

suggestions.title: Pull official depth charts to verify backup-replacing-starter deficiencies
suggestions.rationale: The injury report verifies status but not depth order; depth charts confirm the 2nd/3rd/4th-string designation.
suggestions.impact: High — converts deficiency ANALYSIS into VERIFIED.

suggestions.title: Add a weekly injury-refresh job to the build pipeline
suggestions.rationale: Injuries change weekly; a scheduled refresh keeps the injuries page current and re-verified.

suggestions.title: Define numeric validation thresholds and back-test them
suggestions.rationale: Sample-size and skill-vs-luck thresholds are concepts; concrete, back-tested numbers are needed to rank strategies.

suggestions.title: Document the market-reference policy
suggestions.rationale: Clarify whether any non-official market reference is used and how it is labelled, so 'edge' is computed honestly.

suggestions.title: Add a walk-forward out-of-sample harness
suggestions.rationale: VG-5 requires out-of-sample evaluation; a harness prevents in-sample overfitting from entering rankings.
